title: Flatten a grid (nested loops + accumulator)
description: Write a function `flatten(grid)` that takes a list of lists (a grid) and returns a single flat list containing every element, in row-major order (row by row, left to right).
hints: This combines two patterns you already know: the accumulator (building a result list) and nested loops (visiting a grid row by row).
For each row in the grid, loop over that row's elements and append each one to the result.
expected_behavior: Returns a single flat list with every grid element in order.
explanation: The outer loop visits each row; the inner loop visits each item within that row, appending straight into the shared result list rather than building a separate list per row.
